meetings.title: Northwind Logistics - pricing review
meetings.summary: Priya is aligned on the Platform tier at 84k. Two blockers before signature: CFO Daniel Okafor approves all spend above 50k and has not seen the business case; IT (led by Greg Sullivan) requires a security review. Priya asked for the security pack and a one-page ROI summary she can forward. She would like to go live before peak season.
action_items: Send one-page ROI summary for the CFO
Priya to introduce Greg Sullivan from IT

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Honestly the price is fine from my side. The thing is, anything over fifty thousand goes to Daniel, our CFO, and he hasn't been in any of these conversations.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Understood. What does Daniel usually need to see?

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: A one-pager. Payback period, what we stop paying for. He won't read a deck. And Greg in IT will want your security documents before anyone signs, he blocked a vendor last year over that.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: I can get you both this week. Would it help if I joined a short call with Daniel?

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Maybe. Let me read the one-pager first. I can introduce you to Greg though. We really want this live before peak season in eight weeks.

meetings.title: Brightline Health - evaluation check-in
meetings.summary: Brightline is running a two-vendor evaluation against Corvid. Marcus owns the decision; the CIO, Helen Abara, gives final approval but is not yet engaged. Aiko's main concern is HL7 integration effort and who maintains the mappings. Corvid has offered a free three-month pilot.
action_items: Schedule technical deep-dive on HL7 integration

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lindqvist
transcript.text: To be transparent we're looking at Corvid as well. They've offered three months free as a pilot.

transcript.speaker: Aiko Tanaka
transcript.text: My worry is HL7. Last integration took my team four months and we still maintain the mappings by hand.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lindqvist
transcript.text: I'll make the recommendation, but Helen, our CIO, signs off. She'll ask who else in healthcare is running this in production.

meetings.title: Halcyon Media - discovery

transcript.speaker: Sofia Marchetti
transcript.text: If we can prove it on one show I can take it to our COO, James. He holds the budget for anything new.
